239:   def pbCalcDamage(user, target, numTargets = 1)
240:     return if statusMove?
241:     if target.damageState.disguise || target.damageState.iceFace
242:       target.damageState.calcDamage = 1
243:       return
244:     end
245:     max_stage = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
246:     stageMul = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
247:     stageDiv = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_DIVISORS
248:     # Get the move's type
249:     type = @calcType   # nil is treated as physical
250:     # Calculate whether this hit deals critical damage
251:     target.damageState.critical = pbIsCritical?(user, target)
252:     # Calcuate base power of move
253:     baseDmg = pbBaseDamage(@power, user, target)
254:     # Calculate user's attack stat
255:     atk, atkStage = pbGetAttackStats(user, target)
256:     if !target.hasActiveAbility?(:UNAWARE) || @battle.moldBreaker
257:       atkStage = max_stage if target.damageState.critical && atkStage < max_stage
258:       atk = (atk.to_f * stageMul[atkStage] / stageDiv[atkStage]).floor
259:     end
260:     # Calculate target's defense stat
261:     defense, defStage = pbGetDefenseStats(user, target)
262:     if !user.hasActiveAbility?(:UNAWARE)
263:       defStage = max_stage if target.damageState.critical && defStage > max_stage
264:       defense = (defense.to_f * stageMul[defStage] / stageDiv[defStage]).floor
265:     end
266:     # Calculate all multiplier effects
267:     multipliers = {
268:       :power_multiplier        => 1.0,
269:       :attack_multiplier       => 1.0,
270:       :defense_multiplier      => 1.0,
271:       :final_damage_multiplier => 1.0
272:     }
273:     pbCalcDamageMultipliers(user, target, numTargets, type, baseDmg, multipliers)
274:     # Main damage calculation
275:     baseDmg = [(baseDmg * multipliers[:power_multiplier]).round, 1].max
276:     atk     = [(atk     * multipliers[:attack_multiplier]).round, 1].max
277:     defense = [(defense * multipliers[:defense_multiplier]).round, 1].max
278:     damage  = ((((2.0 * user.level / 5) + 2).floor * baseDmg * atk / defense).floor / 50).floor + 2
279:     damage  = [(damage * multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier]).round, 1].max
280:     target.damageState.calcDamage = damage
281:   end
